name: Economic-horizon RankIC and fixed15 selection-rule ablations
weight_update: first available weekly signal of each month; 252 matured daily IC observations; minimum120; positive mean IC; factor cap20%; maximum monthly movement5 percentage points
horizon_reason: Short reversal and short risk are evaluated on5 sessions; valuation, accounting information, growth and medium trend are evaluated on20 sessions. This is fixed before results and is not optimized per factor.

weight_rules.SHORT_REVERSAL: remove20-day and60-day momentum from the timing family; remaining11 factors use5-session IC
weight_rules.TREND_FLOOR: start from BASE_5D monthly weights; impose minimum10% nominal weight on each of MOMENTUM and MOMENTUM_60D, scaling all other factors proportionally; no return-based tuning
weight_rules.MULTI_HORIZON: each factor uses the predeclared5- or20-session IC above; otherwise same positive-IC capped monthly update

selection_ablations.FULL: original held-top30 buffer, correlation,20% single-industry and35% technology-theme caps
selection_ablations.NO_BUFFER: old holdings receive priority only while still in score Top15, not Top30
selection_ablations.NO_CORRELATION: do not reject a candidate for pair correlation or missing pair correlation
selection_ablations.NO_INDUSTRY_CAP: remove single-industry cap; retain technology aggregate cap
selection_ablations.NO_TECH_CAP: remove technology aggregate cap; retain single-industry cap

ablation_scope: Run all five selection forms for BASE_5D and MULTI_HORIZON at3bp. Run FULL for all four weight rules at3bp and13bp. Every ablation removes exactly one rule; it is not a candidate for automatic adoption.
unchanged: same point-in-time broad tradable universe,13 traditional factors, family restandardization, weekly stock selection, fixed15 equal stock targets, daily15% target-vol budget with20%-100% bounds, next-session-close execution and repaired corporate-action/delisting ledger
validation: Report full period, three predeclared subperiods and calendar years. Conclusions require cross-period evidence; Cambricon is diagnostic only and never an optimization target.
limitations: Retrospective research on already observed data; no untouched holdout and no paper/live promotion.
Twenty-session labels overlap and monthly weights are estimates, not stable causal parameters.
Only two economically chosen horizons are tested; this does not establish an optimal horizon.
Fractional shares, simplified fees and research close execution remain; repaired delisting rights are conditional on documented confirmation assumptions.
Leave-one-out effects need not add up because selection rules interact and change subsequent held-state buffers and risk budgets.
